name: cloudflare-ddns
description: Self-hosted dynamic DNS for domains on Cloudflare

scripts.build: npm --prefix server ci && npm --prefix server run build:dashboard
scripts.deploy: cd server && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && npx wrangler deploy

CF_API_TOKEN.description: Cloudflare API token the app uses to update DNS records. Create a [custom token](https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens) with **Zone → Zone → Read** and **Zone → DNS → Edit** on the zones your machines will use.

ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Your Cloudflare Access team domain, e.g. `myteam.cloudflareaccess.com`. If you haven't set up Access yet, enter `todo` and change it after the deploy (see docs/deployment.md).

ACCESS_AUD.description: Application Audience (AUD) tag of the Access application that protects the dashboard. Enter `todo` for now if you don't have it; the dashboard stays locked until it is set.

RELEASES_REPO.description: GitHub repository the client binaries are fetched from. Leave the default unless you publish your own builds.
